content.text:
Fixed: the checkbox labels in the New Project form no longer have their bottoms cut off. The container itself was never too small. gpui-kit's `Checkbox` squeezes its label into a box exactly one letter-height tall and clips anything outside it, so the bottoms of letters like `p` and `y` and the parentheses in "OpenCode (.opencode)" got cut. The folder browser's "Show hidden" checkbox had the same problem.

**Fix:** a small helper in `src/checkbox.rs` builds a checkbox with the label passed in as its own child, with enough line height for those letter bottoms and centred on the box. Clicking the label still toggles it. The New Project agent checkboxes and "Show hidden" both use it.

**Test:** the New Project UI test now shrinks the window to 1000×560 and checks each agent row's label: it must be taller than a single tight line and stay inside its row. I put the old tight line height back temporarily and the test failed on the first agent's label; with the fix it passes. The suite shows 132 passed, 1 skipped (it needs the real harness), and the same palette test failing as before. The build has no warnings.

**Spec:** `NewProjectScope` (agents) and `FolderBrowserScope` (Show hidden) now say the labels show in full. `piton check` and `piton build check` pass.

I haven't looked at the form on screen, so it's worth a quick glance to confirm the labels look right.
